source_build: ACNH main.elf from the locally extracted game build; same RomFS/ExeFS corpus used by the static UI analysis

method.resolution: R_AARCH64_RELATIVE relocation at address_point + 0x170 resolves to an AArch64 ADRP/ADD/RET getter; its returned NUL-terminated string is compared exactly to screen_catalog layout names.
method.interpretation: The code-pointer slot returns a string identical to a catalogued layout name. This is a static page-to-layout identifier crosswalk; the slot's semantic name, caller, loader handoff, runtime ownership, instantiation, and rendering are not established.

limits: The 135 pages are those matching the existing shared-factory scan, not a proof of every page in the game.
An exact returned string does not prove that a loader calls the method or that the page loads, owns, or renders that BFLYT.
No direct B/BL instruction targets any of the 135 getter functions; indirect calls are not associated with a page receiver by this static crosswalk.
A returned identifier absent from the available 523-layout catalog may resolve through another archive, version, alias, or no resource; this static corpus does not decide which.
